title: Rackphone / Unit
description: One device in detail. Pick a unit above.

panels.title: Charge
panels.description: Yellow above 90% is deliberate: a cabled pack should not live up there.

panels.title: Root
panels.description: Without root the guard cannot run and several series disappear.

panels.title: Charge level and window
panels.description: Window bounds are plotted as series, so a config change is visible on the chart.

panels.title: Current
panels.description: Sign convention is vendor-defined on this kernel; read direction as relative.

panels.title: Charging state
panels.description: State, not magnitude - a timeline reads better than two flat lines at 0 and 1.

panels.title: Battery and connector temperature
panels.description: Connector temperature is the one that matters for a phone left cabled for months.

panels.title: Key zones
panels.description: Eight zones, not all 23: past roughly eight series a line chart stops being readable.

panels.title: All zones, latest
panels.description: Temperature is magnitude, so one sequential ramp rather than 23 cycled hues.

panels.title: Network throughput
panels.description: Counters are stored and the rate computed at query time - never store a pre-computed rate.

panels.title: RSRP
panels.description: One measure per panel. RSRP, RSRQ and SINR have different scales, and a shared axis would misrepresent all three.

panels.title: Scrape cost
panels.description: If the host round-trip climbs toward the 10s scrape timeout, the USB link is degrading.
